content:
Ms. Thomas. I'm not feeling well.
What is it, Elizabeth?
My head hurts.
You may have a headache.
Yes, I think I do.
Let's go see the school nurse.
Okay, Ms. Thomas.
I'll be back in class. Try to be quiet.
